scope: Current mansion exterior, irregular roofline, turrets and surviving wings. The two stories describe the same building; research current geometry independently of the ghost legends.

facts: Surviving structure is wood-framed QueenAnne with Eastlake elements.
Exterior has many finial-crowned gables, two chateauesque towers, porches, stained glass, cut shinglework and skylighted rectangular cupolas.
Restoration had continued from1973; original recorded construction1884–1922.

facts: The1906earthquake damaged the house; seven-storey tower and much fourth-floor fabric were subsequently demolished.
Construction stopped at SarahWinchester’s death in1922.
